mismatch_table.brief: due date (now minus days_late) + 24 calendar days (brief-1 rule 18, brief-2 table)
mismatch_table.spec_and_agent: spec bands[recent].deadline = calendar_days_after_today n=24; compiled code computes today + 24 and ignores days_late. Prose in the negotiate node states the correct rule, but the facts node feeds the model the wrong date.
mismatch_table.evidence: variable_table in every recent-band call: p1_deadline=2026-11-07 for 4, 5, 6, 12 and 20 days late (correct: 10-26 for 12 d, 11-02 for 5 d, 11-01 for 6 d, 10-18 for 20 d). Recorded dates in PROBE-04: 11-05, 10-20, 11-02, never 10-26. Extractor flagged the schema gap in extraction_notes but the compile did not fail or fall back.

mismatch_table.topic: floors, credit card 12% and personal loan 45%
mismatch_table.brief: credit card 12% of past due, personal loan 45% of past due, car loan instalment_amount
mismatch_table.spec_and_agent: only car_loan -> instalment_amount is structured. facts say 'floor amount: unknown' for card and loan; persuasion attempts 2 and 3 show 'unknown'. The model computes percentages from prose (243.00, 21.60 offered correctly), but the create_promise pre-hook treats the floor as unknown and overwrites the amount with the FULL amount.
mismatch_table.evidence: PROBE-03 (personal loan 540.00, customer agreed 243.00): read-back said 243.00, create_promise body amount=540.0, ledger promise 540.0, 3 of 3 sim runs plus the orphan sim run. The agent then said the confirmation sentence without telling the customer the recorded value differed (the tool result's what_to_do_next asked it to).

mismatch_table.brief: floor amount on the 3rd business day after today (= 2026-10-20 with holidays)
mismatch_table.spec_and_agent: date_rule next_business_day placeholder. facts: 'attempt 3 offer: unknown on 2026-10-15' (next business day).
mismatch_table.evidence: PROBE-08 facts and transcript: third offer was dated 2026-10-21 (the model improvised), neither 10-15 nor the correct 10-20.

mismatch_table.spec_and_agent: single structured window hour_end 17:00; Thursday 14:00 exists only in verbatim prose. Same node also contradicts itself: 'ask for another time, at most once' next to 'You may ask twice'.
mismatch_table.evidence: PROBE-07: in 3 of 3 sim runs the agent rejected Thursday 15:30 from the prose and booked 11:00, so behaviour was right, but only because of the LLM; a structural check would pass 15:30.

mismatch_table.evidence: 30 of 30 sim transcripts begin with 'Is this Mr/Ms X?'. (Through the chat route the intro came first, so this depends on the entry path; the simulation path is the one scored.)

mismatch_table.evidence: PROBE-05 and PROBE-06 (3/3 each): no goodbye. PROBE-07 (3/3): 'Goodbye.' without thanks. run1 PROBE-01: nothing said after create_promise.

mismatch_table.evidence: PROBE-04 run1: read-back 2026-11-07, recorded 2026-11-05; PROBE-03 amount 243 -> 540; PROBE-09 loan 10-18 expected, recorded 10-20.

a_ambiguity_resolution.planted: Karim: a refusal on the biggest balance makes the whole call no_promise/refused even if a smaller product has a promise. Priya: Dana's closing table rules (any promise -> promise). Never settled in brief-2.
a_ambiguity_resolution.resolution: Priya's table won. closing.aggregation precedence is transfer > any_promise > all_notes_equal(paid) > first_note_not_equal. The extractor said so in spec warnings and extraction_notes.md ('Priya's table was used').
a_ambiguity_resolution.verdict: sensible default (the one NOTES.md expected) and surfaced in the build warnings; not visible to the agent at call time and not probed with a refuse-big/promise-small call.

b_online_test.failure_cause: GET /api/v2/simulations/<id> returned 504 for the whole batch; testing stopped, workflow unchanged
skipped_kinds: date clamping: the deadline itself is not a business day, so no promise could be recorded on it
multi-product: no carrier account has products with different deadlines
b_online_test.note: The date-clamping skip is itself a symptom of mismatch 1: with deadline = today + 24 = 2026-11-07 (a Saturday) the generator cannot place a promise on it. manual_steps_during_evaluation: The first probe launch left simulation 98809114-... running on the platform for about 2 hours (runs retrying on 5xx). It held the workspace's single simulation slot; there is no documented cancel call so I waited for it to finish and did not call undocumented endpoints.
Added a GET-retry wrapper for 5xx inside my own rehearsal/probe_runner.py (freya.py untouched).

While blocked I built a fallback chat harness (rehearsal/chat_probe.py, chat route + LLM customer + LLM judge). Its runs are NOT used in any tally: the chat route disagrees with the simulation path (intro order, close_call outcome on chat end) and returned many 504s. Artifacts kept: results/rehearsal-probes-chat-*.json/stdout and results/rehearsal-chat-*.json.
One real data point was recovered from the stuck simulation: PROBE-03 call ed4180c7... (results/rehearsal-orphan-PROBE-03-*.json) showing amount 243 -> 540.
